name: Unlock Birdwatching Route
summary: Start with the mentor route, camera or binocular handoff, and one easy observation before chasing rare birds.
steps: Open the birdwatching hobby prompt
Confirm the camera or binocular tool route
Take one starter bird photo
Save the first confirmed location note

name: Weather Window Route
summary: Use weather as the first filter before walking every region.
steps: Check current weather before leaving town
Run sunny or clear starter checks first
Move rain-only candidates into checklist
Do not reroute for rare birds until weather matches

name: Habitat Loop Route
summary: Split birds by forest, coast, town, and mountain loops so collection does not become random wandering.
steps: Start with town and flower field checks
Move to forest or lake edges for nature birds
Use coast routes after fishing or shell stops
Save mountain checks for onsen or late routes

name: Pose And Photo Route
summary: Treat photo quality as a task state: sighting, clear shot, and confirmed album row.
steps: Approach slowly before opening camera
Wait for a clean pose or perch
Take the photo before moving closer
Record whether the album accepted the shot

name: Rare Bird Priority
summary: Rare birds should be tracked by condition, not searched during every casual route.
steps: Record missing bird names and suspected habitat
Add weather and time gates to each target
Pair rare searches with nearby map tasks
Stop after the condition window ends

name: Daily Collection Loop
summary: Use birdwatching as a light daily route that pairs with NPC, map, and photo tasks.
steps: Pick one bird route for the day
Combine it with one NPC or shop stop
Mark confirmed sightings in checklist
Leave rare-only routes for matching weather
